title: 分组表头查询被分页截断时丢掉 hasMore：看板泳道合计可能显示「合计 0」或少算，且没有任何提示
body:
triage#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbZKP5YM48rWMWTS7wE

Filing gate: ① a defect with a named location, filed by triage at repo:objectstack#3's request (mailbox #36743, comment 7123381260, item 1). Source: L2 record 7123350562 on PR #36857 (#36520), item S3, outside that diff.

## What happens

On a deployment that sets `OS_DATA_DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE` or `OS_DATA_MAX_PAGE_SIZE`, a grouped read without a `limit` is cut to the default page size. The server answers `hasMore: true` (`protocol-data-crud.ts` ~644–678, `packages/types/src/query-read-limits.ts` ~255).

`queryGroupHeaders` in `ui/packages/data-objectstack/src/index.ts` (~7700–7715, main 76bff41f) returns `records` alone, so the caller cannot tell a cut answer from a whole one.

The kanban lane statistic from PR #36857 then reads an absent group as an empty lane (`laneFigureOf` in `KanbanLaneStatistic.ts`). When the filtered set holds more distinct lane values than one page, a lane with records can draw "Sum 0", and "Uncategorized" can draw an understated total, with no marker.

reach: read from code by the L2, not run. It reaches boards with a `sum` summary on deployments that cap the page size, where lanes come from the data (lookup lanes) or the field has many values outside the lanes.

## Expected

A grouped answer that the server cut says so. A board then draws no figure for an answer it knows is partial, rather than a wrong total.

## Acceptance

- `queryGroupHeaders` hands back the server's `hasMore`, or an equivalent "partial" flag, beside `records`. Its callers keep working: the grouped grid, `usedCurrencyCodes` and the kanban lane statistic.
- The kanban lane statistic draws no figure, for any lane, when the grouped answer is partial.
- A test drives a grouped read capped by a small default page size and asserts that the flag is set and that no lane figure is drawn.

## Order

After PR #36857 merges. The lane statistic that reads the flag lands there.

Blocked-by: #36857

Dedupe: open issues for `queryGroupHeaders hasMore` and for a grouped read truncated by page size return none. #36520 is the parent card.
